notes: Two taḥwīl branches with their own heads and one shared tail after «شعيب»; أبي is the father of ابن معاذ, named by relation only
«زاد ابن معاذ» and «وزاد موسى» are wording additions, and «قال يقول لاحق» is a commentary, so all three are left out
أبو هريرة is the last link: Bashir relays his words («قال قال أبو هريرة»)
